_comment: Project policy snippet for the Collibra MCP demo. Paste the object under `policy` (or the equivalent fields in the dashboard's PolicyFloorEditor) into your project's policy on staging. Without this, the 'finance' scenario will NOT be blocked.

tool_arg_constraints._purpose: Writes to a schema must target an allow-listed schema.
Same rule for column additions — only the allowed schemas may be mutated.
Classification tags must come from the agreed taxonomy (no free-text labels in the catalog).
